evidence_items.explanation: High performance on the semi-private abstract-reasoning tasks contradicts a general description of very poor reasoning. The prose reports 91.2% for v2 while the verified table reports 91.3%; this small discrepancy does not affect that conclusion.

The physics evaluation uses a private 40-question hard subset and a code-execution tool. The same report separately gives Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra 78% on HLE-Diamond's reasoning questions, providing evidence of competence across providers and task types.

Testing occurred October 2–5 without human input; expert grading found seven correct solutions from the direct GPT-6 Astra test and nine from ProofCouncil. The report also records major errors throughout the open-weight entrant's submissions and remaining citation and exposition weaknesses.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5, Correct analogies support LLMs solving ARCANA
evidence_items.explanation: The paper reports a human-model gap on far analogical reasoning. Its tested models are GPT 5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus 4.5, and Grok 4.1 Fast, so it does not directly establish the October frontier's capabilities.

unresolved_gaps: The cited evaluations do not establish reliable reasoning in every real-world setting.
The available ARCANA study does not test the leading models evaluated in the October success reports.
